The scattered yellow leaves in an otherwise green, healthy-looking mid-season canopy — without pronounced dead zones, vascular symptoms, or mold — is most consistent with **Septoria brown spot**, which progresses from lower to upper canopy as scattered dark brown lesions causing premature leaf yellowing visible from a distance.
